artifact: Plan receipt and approval (WP-3.9): the payloads of a COSE_Sign1 `permguard.operation.plan.v1` and of a COSE_Sign1 `permguard.operation.approval.v1`, each of the profile in crates/permguard-objects/src/cose.rs and signed by the Host's host.operations key under its <ring>:<thumbprint> kid; and the plan body whose digest both name
authority: 1-architecture/9-architecture-patterns.md P9, 6-contracts/8-contract-host-api.md (plan receipt, dual control), owner decisions of 2026-10-11 (labels, types, approvals); crates/permguard-host/src/operations/plan.rs (PlanReceipt, Approval, plan_digest)
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: revision
fields.note: the target's revision or epoch the plan was made at

fields.name: principal
fields.note: the planner, who alone runs it

fields.name: expires
fields.note: seconds since the epoch; 10 minutes on, a day when approvals are required

fields.name: approvals_required
fields.note: how many principals other than the planner must approve

fields.name: plan_digest
fields.note: the plan digest the approval names

fields.name: principal
fields.note: the principal who approved, authenticated by the Host

fields.name: host_id
fields.note: 16 bytes, the Host that attests it

fields.name: parameters
fields.note: what else the plan fixes: a key revocation's `reason` and `compromised_at`, a membership revocation's `reason`, a reset's `mode`, `memberships` and `reason`; empty allowed
